changeinfo.changes: • Fixed a crash when trying to play multiplayer with an account with many friends (2000+) • Added more vibration events (losing a round, etc.) • Fixed crashes related to disconnecting/logging out at various stages during play • Fixed Runner Selection screen displaying incorrect information on clients when removing bots • Fixed potential player desync issues when a player would drop out of a 4 player game during the loading screen • Fixed memory leak during multiplayer games • Implemented better handling of local multiplayer regards to controller support (controller disconnect message no longer appears and pauses game during multiplayer) • Fixed matchmaking becoming unusable after repeatedly opening and closing sessions
